text:
Zoe (Finance): follow-up from the postmortem: we need a clear remediation plan for the delayed-usage token overcount. three lanes: engineering mitigation, billing corrections, and customer outreach. owners?

Ken (Eng): i'll own engineering. initial theory: lagged telemetry replay combined with out-of-order commit caused duplicate token entries in the metering service. i'll produce a repro script, a short-term ingest dedupe, and a CI regression that replays late events weekly. ETA for repro + canary dedupe: 2026-04-02 20:00 UTC.

Pri (Billing): billing will do the mapping and corrections. need eng to provide a CSV mapping request_id -> customer_id -> event_time -> token_delta. once we have that we'll group by invoice and prepare credit memos. target to run first controlled correction on 2026-04-05.

Omar (Support): Support will prepare outbound templates and an escalation playbook for enterprise customers. please flag any customer-specific notes. i'll also set up a shared doc for ticket tracking.

Ken (Eng): quick query to start (no PI):
```
SELECT r.request_id, r.customer_id, r.event_time, r.reported_tokens, m.estimated_tokens, (r.reported_tokens - m.estimated_tokens) AS token_delta
FROM reported_tokens r JOIN model_estimates m USING (request_id)
WHERE r.event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-01 23:59:59'
AND (r.reported_tokens - m.estimated_tokens) > 40
ORDER BY token_delta DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```
I'll upload CSV to s3://billing-incidents/2410005678/affected.csv by 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC.

MeterBot: file_uploaded by @ken-eng at 2026-04-02T08:05:12Z; path=s3://billing-incidents/2410005678/affected.csv; rows=378; size=96KB

Pri (Billing): received. quick policy question: for invoices already reconciled and paid, do we refund or issue account credits? Zoe please confirm.

Zoe (Finance): policy for this incident: refunds only if requested and amount > $400; otherwise apply account credit. Enterprise customers get line-item corrections and a reconciled statement. document this in the remediation notes.

Omar (Support): drafting two templates: (A) enterprise detailed notice with line-item breakdown and (B) general customer notice with account credit info. will post drafts by 2026-04-03 12:00 UTC.

Ken (Eng): short-term mitigation: implement a 15s dedupe window at ingest and a metric "metering_duplicate_rate". I'll add a PagerDuty alert if rate > 0.25% daily. Long-term: remove reliance on replay-order without idempotency keys.

Pri (Billing): mapping complete: ~97 invoices affected, 26 > $1k, estimated adjustment ~$16,700. prepping credit memos and will run a pilot batch of 20 invoices on 2026-04-05 09:00 PST.

Zoe (Finance): action summary and owners:
- Ken (Eng): repro, canary dedupe, CI replay test, PD alert (due 2026-04-02 EOD)
- Pri (Billing): invoice mapping, pilot corrections, full batch after validation (pilot 2026-04-05)
- Omar (Support): comms templates + ticket playbook (draft 2026-04-03 noon)

Zoe (Finance): also request we add a weekly metering audit that compares reported_tokens vs model_estimate at the invoice-level to detect recurring patterns. Ken please add a dashboard.

Ken (Eng): will add Grafana panel and a weekly job that emits an anomaly signal if invoice-level delta > 0.5%. posting alert config after deploy.

Pri (Billing): pilot scheduled. will post results and reconciliation CSV here after run.

Omar (Support): acknowledged. will standby for customer replies and escalate refund requests > $400 to Finance.

Zoe (Finance): thanks all. i'll track completion in the remediation tracker and loop in legal if any customers request refunds. update thread when tasks are done. :white_check_mark:
